main.description: A pre-defined TypeScript policy set. Used as the referenced record inside the RFP's policy field: an evaluator resolves the strongRef, reads the named policies, and evaluates them in-process from the bundled manifest code. The bundle is a strong reference to a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.deno.workerManifest (the first-party/trusted variant of com.publicdomainrelay.temp.market.policies.denoWorker, whose code is our own pre-seeded bundle rather than untrusted third-party code).

name.description: Stable name of the policy set, e.g. market-builtins.

policies.description: Named policies evaluated by the manifest bundle; all must allow.

manifest.description: Strong reference to a com.publicdomainrelay.temp.compute.deno.workerManifest holding the bundled policy code (the bundle).

permissions.description: Deno sandbox permissions requested by the bundle (net, read, write, env, run, ffi, sys, import). Applied on top of the default deny-all posture.

signatures.description: badge.blue attestations over this policy record.

name.description: Registry name of the policy to run (for example open, bidder-only-me, requester-only-me, bidder-tangled-vouch, under-4-cpus, bid-payload).

description.description: Human-readable description of what this policy admits.

args.description: Arguments passed to the policy at evaluation time. Well-known keys: bidWindowSec, firstFree.
